paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Distribution of Pass@1 accuracy of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on MATH-500, divided into five bins.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of Pass@1 accuracy of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on MATH-500, organized into five sequential continuous bins. The horizontal axis represents the "Pass@1" score categories, displaying a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, which define the boundaries of the five equal-width bins. The vertical axis represents the "Percentage" as a decimal value, utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 with regular tick intervals of 0.1, accompanied by light gray horizontal grid lines spanning the chart. The chart features individual, unstacked bars for each bin, all colored light blue with solid black outlines. The value of each bar is visually represented by its height against the vertical axis and is explicitly provided by text annotations situated directly above each bar. From left to right, the first bar (spanning 0.0 to 0.2) corresponds to a value of 0.112 and is annotated "11.2%". The shortest bars represent the second (0.2 to 0.4) and third (0.4 to 0.6) bins, both reaching a value of 0.034 and annotated "3.4%". The fourth bar (0.6 to 0.8) extends to 0.058 and is annotated "5.8%". The fifth and tallest bar covers the 0.8 to 1.0 bin, reaching a value of 0.762 with an annotation of "76.2%". The bins are sequentially sorted in ascending numerical order along the horizontal axis. Additional visual emphasis is provided by a vertical dashed red line positioned along the horizontal axis at the 0.82 mark, intersecting the tallest bar, with corresponding red text to its left reading "mean: 0.82".
